schema.sessions: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sid TEXT UNIQUE, username TEXT, valid INTEGER DEFAULT 1, created_at REAL)
schema.runtime_probe: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runtime_probe (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), marker TEXT NOT NULL, representation TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL)
schema.body_config: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS body_config (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), variant TEXT, content TEXT)

downstream_lane.note: a downstream lane may promote any advisory component to required in its own preregistration; absence of an advisory component cannot veto runtime.A

probe_discipline.python_dependencies: isolated subprocess with sys.executable, import check, short timeout
probe_discipline.browsergym_agentlab: isolated import check; never a synthetic success
probe_discipline.policy_model_credential: environment-key presence booleans only; never token values
probe_discipline.hf_ghcr: bounded read-only HTTP reachability with explicit timeout, status code and latency; no model download
probe_discipline.chromium_launch: public Playwright API probe (sync_playwright().start().chromium.executable_path preferred; public p.chromium.launch() equivalent); no playwright._impl or private helper
probe_discipline.fail_closed: a timeout, import exception, missing executable or non-2xx reachability result is UNAVAILABLE/ERROR with evidence, never silently upgraded to AVAILABLE

idempotence: the command acquires the run lock, refuses to kill unrelated processes, replace a foreign config or overwrite a foreign lock, and returns non-zero for a failed required scope
